properties.source: The merge-survivor root-cause pass (read-only, 2026-10-14) and @ajs's own word in the dev_reflow2 session
properties.statement:
OBSERVED during the merge-survivor root cause (fact:root-cause-a-merge-deletes-the-wrong-node-because-the-survivor-rule-is-blind-to-status-priority-and-connections-2026-10-14):
- This decision's own text still says "PROPOSED … AWAITING ANTHONY'S WORD". Its status reads accepted.
- The status flipped proposed→accepted in commit 2361a4d3c (reflow2 #147, a PR about fabrication), with no ChangeEvent and no approver edge for the acceptance. It sits on the authority check's grandfathered list.
- No code ever implemented it: merge_survivor last changed 2026-07-20, and it still breaks ties by node id.
- The 2026-09-15 ruling decision:ack:d0098626ac85ac53 reaffirms the id tiebreak ("UNCHANGED, DELIBERATELY").

@ajs, 2026-10-14, asked whether he had accepted it on 2026-08-10: "I don't remember accepting the degree decision".

So its accepted status was never the owner's word. It returns to proposed. The superseding decision ("the engine proposes, a person picks", his 2026-10-13 ruling) will retire it, together with dec:merge-survivor-provenance, when the merge-survivor code change lands.
